lead.en: A Kense-branded status mark for assistant activity.
lead.zh: 使用 Kense 标识展示助手活动状态。

rule.en: The host sets activity and visibility; this visual does not request devices or perform AI work. The preview simulates activity.
rule.zh: 宿主设置活动状态和可见性；视觉本身不请求设备或执行 AI 任务。预览为模拟状态。

api.en: Set Idle, Listening, Thinking, Writing, Done or Error. with_size accepts 24–160 logical pixels; set_visible and set_paused suspend motion. follow_pointer controls pointer following.
api.zh: 可设置 Idle、Listening、Thinking、Writing、Done 或 Error。with_size 支持 24–160 逻辑像素；set_visible 和 set_paused 暂停动效；follow_pointer 控制指针跟随。

motion.en: Kense mark poses blend over 420 ms with a companion dot, writing line, completion and error cues. Reduced motion holds a representative pose; hidden views stop frame requests and resume their clock. The artwork and motion are original Kense treatments and still need visual verification.
motion.zh: Kense 标识的状态在 420ms 内过渡，并配有伴随点、书写线、完成及错误提示。减少动效时保持静态姿态；隐藏时停止请求帧并保留时间进度。画面和动作采用原创 Kense 处理，仍需视觉验收。
